page: Running Hono on Cloudflare Workers edge runtime with Wrangler CLI. Wrangler includes transcompiler for TypeScript. Setup: npm create hono@latest my-app, select cloudflare-workers. Install: npm i. Hello World: standard Hono app with export default. Run: npm run dev, access http://localhost:8787. Port configuration: wrangler.toml or CLI flags. Deploy: npm run deploy. Other event handlers: export object with fetch, scheduled properties. Static files: assets feature in wrangler.jsonc with directory property. Types: @cloudflare/workers-types for type definitions. Testing: @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers with app.request(). Bindings: R2Bucket, KV, Durable Objects, environment values via c.env. Generate types: wrangler types --env-interface. Variables in middleware: access c.env in middleware setup. GitHub Actions deploy: workflow with cloudflare/wrangler-action, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret. Environment variables: .dev.vars or .env file (dotenv format), access via c.env.*. Set secrets in dashboard before deployment. Questions: How do I set up Cloudflare Workers? How do I use bindings? How do I test? How do I deploy with CI? How do I use environment variables?

sections.manifest: Cloudflare Workers setup. Create project: npm create hono@latest my-app, select cloudflare-workers. Install: npm i (yarn, pnpm, bun variants). File: src/index.ts with Hono app. Export: export default app. Wrangler: manages deployment, transcompilation. Questions: How do I create project? What's the entry point?

Hello World. File: src/index.ts. Code: new Hono(), app.get('/', c => c.text('Hello!')), export default app. Dev: npm run dev, access http://localhost:8787. TypeScript support without manual transpiling. Questions: What's the basic setup? How do I run locally?

Port and development configuration. Default port: 8787. Change port: update wrangler.toml/wrangler.json/wrangler.jsonc or use CLI options. References: Wrangler Configuration, Wrangler CLI docs. Questions: How do I change port? What configuration options exist?

Deployment. Deploy: npm run deploy, yarn deploy, pnpm run deploy, bun run deploy. Requires Cloudflare account. package.json $npm_execpath set to package manager. Simple one-command deployment. Questions: How do I deploy? What's required?

Module Worker mode with other event handlers. Export object: { fetch: app.fetch, scheduled: async (batch, env) => {...} }. Enables custom handlers alongside Hono. Use case: scheduled jobs, queues, etc. Questions: How do I add scheduled handlers? How do I use Module Worker mode?

Static file serving with Assets feature. Configuration: wrangler.jsonc assets.directory property set to 'public'. Place files: public/static/hello.txt served as /static/hello.txt. Directory structure: package.json, public/, src/, wrangler.jsonc. Questions: How do I serve static files? Where do I put assets?

Type definitions for Cloudflare. Install: @cloudflare/workers-types. Dev dependency: npm i --save-dev @cloudflare/workers-types. Provides Workers API types. Questions: Why install workers-types? How do I install?

Testing Cloudflare Workers. Framework: @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers. Test example: app.request('http://localhost/'), expect(res.status).toBe(200). Test structure: describe, it, expect from test framework. Reference: honojs/examples for setup. Questions: How do I test? What framework? How do I make requests?

Cloudflare Bindings for environment values, KV, R2, Durable Objects. Type definition: type Bindings = { MY_BUCKET: R2Bucket, USERNAME: string }. Hono type: new Hono<{ Bindings: Bindings }>. Access: c.env.MY_BUCKET, c.env.USERNAME. Example: R2 upload via c.env.MY_BUCKET.put(). Auto-generate types: wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareBindings. Generated file: worker-configuration.d.ts. Questions: What bindings are available? How do I type bindings? How do I access them?

Variables in middleware. Use case: Basic Auth with credentials. Access variables: c.env.USERNAME, c.env.PASSWORD in middleware setup. Pattern: basicAuth({ username: c.env.USERNAME, password: c.env.PASSWORD }). Applies to: Bearer Auth, JWT, others. Questions: How do I use variables in middleware? How do I pass credentials?

GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment. Token setup: create Cloudflare API token from User API Tokens, select 'Edit Cloudflare Workers' template. Store secret: GitHub Settings > Secrets > CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. Workflow file: .github/workflows/deploy.yml with cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3. Configuration: wrangler.jsonc main (src/index.ts), minify (true). Trigger: push to main branch. Questions: How do I set up GitHub Actions? What's the workflow? How do I create token?

Environment variables for local development. Files: .dev.vars or .env in project root. Format: dotenv syntax (KEY=value). Access: c.env.SECRET_KEY in code. Example: SECRET_KEY=value, API_TOKEN=jwt_value. Production setup: configure in Cloudflare dashboard (Workers > Variables). Note: process.env not available by default; use c.env or nodejs_compat_populate_process_env flag. Alternative: import env from 'cloudflare:workers'. Production: set variables before deployment in dashboard. Questions: How do I set env variables locally? How do I use them? Where do I set production variables?
